name: Dumbbell Deadlift
description: With a dumbbell on the floor beside each foot, hinge and bend your knees to grip them, then stand up tall by driving your hips forward, and lower them back down.

source.title: Muscle & Strength: Dumbbell Deadlift
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand with a dumbbell just outside each foot.
cues: Weights stay close to your legs.

prescription.note: Warm up with lighter sets first. Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Set up
keyframes.cue: Hips back, back flat, hands on the bar.

keyframes.name: Stand up
keyframes.cue: Drive through your feet and stand tall.
